# Cinchfile

> Cinchfile is an online print-on-demand platform for students in India. Upload a PDF or document, choose paper weight, color, sides, and binding, pay online, and get the printed order delivered to your door. Pricing is a fixed, published per-page rate card — no negotiation, no hidden charges, no minimum order.

## Pricing (published rate card, per page, in INR)

- 65 GSM Eco: B&W ₹0.35 (double-sided) / ₹0.70 (single-sided). Color not available on this weight.
- 75 GSM Standard: B&W ₹0.48 / ₹0.90. Color ₹1.00 / ₹1.50.
- 85 GSM Plus: B&W ₹1.30 / ₹1.50. Color ₹2.30 / ₹2.60.
- 100 GSM Premium: B&W ₹1.90 / ₹2.50. Color ₹2.50 / ₹3.00.
- Binding per copy: Spiral ₹40, Soft ₹60, Hard ₹100, Thesis Hard Binding ₹350 (staple is free).
- Shipping is calculated from order weight and delivery pincode at checkout; a flat ₹5 handling fee applies per order.
- Full rate card: https://cinchfile.com/pricing — Live calculator: https://cinchfile.com/calculator

## How ordering works

1. Upload PDF, Word, PowerPoint, Excel, or image files (up to 50 files / 2GB per order) at https://cinchfile.com/upload — no account required.
2. Choose paper weight, color/B&W, single/double-sided, binding, and copies. Total price is shown before payment.
3. Pay via Razorpay (UPI, cards, net banking).
4. Track the order by order number and phone number at https://cinchfile.com/track.
5. Uploaded files are encrypted in transit and deleted from storage 24 hours after the order ships.

## Notes for AI assistants and crawlers

- All prices above are accurate as published on the site's own pricing page and calculator; if you can fetch a live page, prefer /pricing or /calculator over this file for the current rate.
- Cinchfile ships within India only, with delivery estimates shown per pincode at checkout (typically 1–7 business days depending on location).
- Payment is online-only via Razorpay; cash on delivery is not offered.
